output.evaluation_note: All three expressions (English 'single', Japanese '単一', Vietnamese 'đơn nhất') align perfectly in conveying the core concept of 'one, sole, unique, not multiple' as an adjective. The Japanese and Vietnamese terms, while Hán-Việt/Sino-Japanese, are natural and common for this specific sense, matching the more formal/unitary aspects of 'single' well.
